# The NASDAQ:AMZN price of prices_of_a_currency_and_a_stock.txt, with its
# currency changed to CAD through its guid.
#
# A price is of one commodity in one currency, and GnuCash's price database
# files each price under that pair, so changing either on an existing price is
# refused. A price in CAD is recorded as a price of its own.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing; the refusal.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_price_is_changed_through_its_guid.py.
price
	guid: "4a1a4c0c7328491fbde9f8099ba280c8"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
